_note: List API prices, USD per 1M tokens, of the models in the kit's paseo/providers.json and their fast variants. Keys are the model id after the provider prefix (circle/<id>, circle-agent/<id>; a [1m] suffix is dropped). longContext: the higher rate once a request passes thresholdTokens. These are public list prices from each provider's official page (source); a proxy's bill can differ. Kit-owned: kit.mjs update replaces this file unless the project edited it. checkedAt (top: the oldest entry) says when each entry was last compared with its source. Refresh in the kit: check every source page, update the numbers, checkedAt and the CHANGELOG.

claude-haiku-4-5.notes: 5m cache write $1.25, 1h cache write $2.00, cache read $0.10.

claude-haiku-5-5.notes: Prompts <=100k tokens: $0.10 input, $0.50 output, $0.125 5m cache write, $0.01 cache read. Prompts >100k tokens: $0.50 input, $2.50 output, $0.625 5m cache write, $0.05 cache read. 1h cache writes are 2x base ($0.20 <=100k, $1.00 >100k).

claude-opus-5-5.notes: Standard pricing across full 1M context window. 5m cache write is 1.25x ($5.00), 1h cache write is 2x ($8.00), cache read is 0.05x ($0.20). Fast mode available at $8.00 input, $40.00 output.

claude-opus-5-5-fast.notes: Fast mode provides faster output at 2x base rates across full context window. Caching multipliers apply on top: 5m cache write 1.25x ($10.00), cache read 0.05x ($0.40).

claude-sonnet-5-5.notes: Standard pricing across full 1M context window. 5m cache write is 1.25x ($2.50), 1h cache write is 2x ($4.00), cache read is 0.05x ($0.10).

gemini-3.8-flash-high.notes: Official model ID is 'gemini-3.8-flash' (no '-high' variant listed on official page; thinking tokens are included in standard output price of $3.75). Standard pricing through Dec 31, 2026: input $0.75, cached input $0.075, output $3.75 (rises to $1.50/$0.15/$7.50 on Jan 1, 2027). No cache write fee; cache storage is $0.50/1M tokens/hour. Priority tier is available at $1.35 input, $0.135 cached input, $6.75 output.

gpt-6-astra.notes: Short context (<=272k): input $10.00, cached input $1.00, cache write $12.50, output $50.00. Long context (>272k): input $20.00, cached input $2.00, cache write $25.00, output $75.00.

gpt-6-astra-fast.notes: Fast tier (priority). Short context (<=272k): input $20.00, cached input $2.00, cache write $25.00, output $100.00. Long context (>272k): input $40.00, cached input $4.00, cache write $50.00, output $150.00.

gpt-6-luna.notes: Short context (<=272k): input $0.10, cached input $0.01, cache write $0.125, output $0.50. Long context (>272k): input $0.20, cached input $0.02, cache write $0.25, output $0.75.

gpt-6-luna-fast.notes: Fast tier. Short context (<=272k): input $0.20, cached input $0.02, cache write $0.25, output $1.00. Long context (>272k): input $0.40, cached input $0.04, cache write $0.50, output $1.50.

grok-4.7.notes: Prompts <200k: input $2.00, cached input $0.50, output $6.00. Prompts >=200k: input $4.00, cached input $1.00, output $12.00. Cache write price not listed. Priority processing is 2x standard rate.

grok-4.7-build-fast.notes: Listed on pricing page under 'Grok 4.7 Fast pricing (Cursor and Grok Build only)': <200k input $4.00, cached input $1.00, output $12.00; >200k input $6.00, cached input $1.50, output $18.00.
